attacker.model: claude (Kiro subagent; exact model version not exposed to the agent)

null-vs-empty.notApplicableReason: The only input is a tinyint; no text input exists. A NULL status is already a fixed case (CASE NULL takes the ELSE branch).

collation-case.notApplicableReason: No text input; the result is a constant chosen by CASE, never compared.

top-ties.notApplicableReason: Scalar function: returns one value, no rows from tables.

identity-gaps.notApplicableReason: Reads no table, no key or sequence.

cases.label: status 5 (second unmapped value above the last WHEN) is the ELSE text
cases.reasoning: A conversion that mapped by range (status > 3) or by array index would agree on 4 but could differ on later values; T-SQL CASE @Status matches only the listed WHEN values.

cases.label: status 127 (signed 1-byte maximum) is the ELSE text
cases.reasoning: tinyint is mapped to smallint on PostgreSQL; a conversion through a signed byte (or a char cast) would wrap at 127/128. SQL Server tinyint is unsigned 0..255.

cases.label: status 128 (one above the signed 1-byte maximum) is the ELSE text, not an error
cases.reasoning: 128 overflows a signed byte; SQL Server tinyint accepts it. The PostgreSQL smallint parameter must accept it and fall to ELSE.

cases.label: status 254 (one below the tinyint maximum) is the ELSE text
cases.reasoning: Upper boundary next to 255; a modulo or bit-mask mapping (status & 3, status % 4) would map 254 to a WHEN text.

cases.label: status 131 (3 + 128, same low bits as a mapped value) is the ELSE text
cases.reasoning: 131 has the same low 7 bits as 3 ('Obsolete'); a conversion that truncated to a signed or 7-bit value would return 'Obsolete'. SQL Server returns the ELSE text.

cases.label: status 1 gives the 16-character text exactly at the nvarchar(16) limit, untruncated
cases.reasoning: 'Pending approval' is exactly 16 characters, the declared length of @ret and the return type. A varchar(15) or a padded char(16) return on PostgreSQL would cut or pad it; SQL Server returns it whole.

objections.text: A06 sends status 1 with no tables, exactly the same payload as the hand-derived fixed case for the Pending approval mapping. That fixed case already checks the full 16-character return value and its declared result type.
